subject: Final-mile takt: signature orchestration & MAP alignment
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Cho <evan.cho@medexexample.com>, MedEx Procurement <procurement@medexexample.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final-mile takt: signature orchestration & MAP alignment

Hi Evan / MedEx team —

Attaching the updated mutual action plan (Redwood_MAP_Final-v2.xlsx) and a short checklist that maps legal/procurement dependencies to concrete dates. Key asks from our side so we can lock the target sign date: 

- Confirm whether SOC 2 Type II evidence + encryption-at-rest jurisdiction note (US-only) are sufficient for your procurement/legal.
- Confirm target signature window (we're proposing 2026-09-22 to align with your fiscal cutover).
- Identify any procurement-specific PO process or approval gates we should include on the MAP (who signs the PO, expected lag).

Quick summary of the MAP milestones (proposed):
- 2026-09-08: MedEx legal to return MSA redlines (tracked)
- 2026-09-10: Redwood provides full SOC2 artifact bundle + SSO metadata (IdP)
- 2026-09-14: Legal agreement on DPA/data residency language
- 2026-09-16: Order form prefill shared and pricing confirmed
- 2026-09-22: Signature target (DocuSign envelope + PO issuance)

If any of these dates look tight on your end, flag them and we can stagger the initial pilot (pilot lane + production lane) so you get a short onramp without blocking the signature pipeline.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Final-v2.xlsx (MAP), OrderForm_Prefill.docx (prefill).

Thanks — looking to close this sprint with minimal legal churn.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123
From: Evan Cho <evan.cho@medexexample.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: MedEx Procurement <procurement@medexexample.com>, Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@medexexample.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile takt: signature orchestration & MAP alignment

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the clear MAP. A few quick items from Legal/Procurement after our internal scrub: 

- SOC 2: we require SOC 2 Type II and the control narrative for encryption keys. Can you confirm whether the evidence includes the control set (CC6, CC7) for key management? We also need confirmation that keys are customer-isolated for Private deployments.
- Data residency: MedEx requires EU/US partitioning for PHI-adjacent metadata; is the DPA draft including a residency clause or do you have a separate addendum?
- Target signature: 2026-09-22 is reasonable but contingent on receiving the MSA redlines by COB 9/8 and SOC2 by 9/10. If legal review slips, we may need to push to 9/29.

Procurement note: we can issue a PO on signature but will need the final order form with the line-item detail and the billing contact (Sophie). I attached a placeholder Intent PDF (MedEx_PO_Intent.pdf) to show our internal pathway — not final.

Two asks for Redwood:
1) Please share the SOC2 bundle + control narrative as a single download (SECEVID preferred).
2) Share SSO metadata (IdP) so our security team can preconfigure the test tenant.

If Karthik will own redlines, can you loop him here so we have a single owner on both sides?

- Evan
Evan Cho
Director, IT Procurement
MedEx Health Systems
evan.cho@medexexample.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Cho <evan.cho@medexexample.com>, MedEx Procurement <procurement@medexexample.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile takt: signature orchestration & MAP alignment

Evan — thanks, got it. Quick answers: 

- SOC2 export: yes — we will provide the full Type II bundle plus the control narrative. I will upload as MedEx_Security_Evidence.zip by 9/10 and share a drive link.
- Keys: for Private deployments we support customer-managed keys; we'll include the KMS/HSM note in the evidence bundle.
- DPA/residency: Karthik (legal) will propose two DPA variants (standard + residency addendum) to choose from — looping him in now.
- Order form: attached OrderForm_Prefill.docx is our prefilled version. Laura will confirm billing contact details and the final line-item breakdown by 9/12.

If MedEx still wants to aim for 9/22, we'll prioritize the redline turnaround and prepare the DocuSign envelope as soon as MSA redlines converge.

Jasmine

---
Attachment stub: OrderForm_Prefill.docx (prefill sent).
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Evan Cho <evan.cho@medexexample.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile takt: signature orchestration & MAP alignment

Evan / Jasmine — I'm Karthik on Redwood Legal. Rapid checklist from our side and proposed redline cadence: 

- I'll send a tracked redline of the MSA by EOD 9/11: MSA_Redline_Karthik_v1.pdf (highlights: data residency addendum option A — EU partitioning; option B — contractual SLA for export controls).
- DPA: I'll include a residency addendum template you can choose; if you prefer our standard DPA + addendum, we'll mark the addendum for signature alongside the Order Form.
- DocuSign: once we align on redlines we'll assemble one envelope containing (MSA + DPA + Order Form) to reduce back-and-forth. Confirm whether MedEx prefers separate documents for legal countersigning or a combined envelope.
- Evidence: Jasmine, confirm that the SOC2 bundle will include the key control narrative KMS/HSM screenshots. If not, we'll add a short attestation.

Operational note: to keep the 9/22 target, we need MedEx to return either (a) clean acceptance of the redline by 9/13 or (b) a narrow set of point comments limited to scope/data residency by 9/14. Anything broader will push signature to 9/29.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@medexexample.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Evan Cho <evan.cho@medexexample.com>
Cc: procurement@medexexample.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile takt: signature orchestration & MAP alignment

Thanks everyone — quick alignment from procurement/security: 

- We received MSA_Redline_Karthik_v1.pdf and will route to Legal by 9/16. Good to see the residency addendum option.
- Security has a short queue but can consume MedEx_Security_Evidence.zip by 9/10; confirmed they will preconfigure the IdP once SSO metadata is received.
- Procurement can commit to issuing the PO on signature day provided the Order Form final line items are confirmed by 9/16 and billing contact is Sophie Tran (that's me).

Next steps (as we see them):
1) Redwood uploads MedEx_Security_Evidence.zip to the drive link and shares SSO metadata by 9/10 (security preconfig).
2) MedEx Legal reviews MSA redline by 9/16 and returns point comments (if any).
3) Finalize Order Form with Laura by 9/16.
4) Target DocuSign signature window: 2026-09-22 to 2026-09-24.

I have attached our PO intent file for internal routing (MedEx_PO_Intent.pdf). We'll follow up if Legal requests a call.

— Sophie
Sophie Tran
Sr. Procurement Manager
MedEx Health Systems
